toolchain: CMake 4.4.2 with Visual Studio 17 2022, MSBuild 17.14.40, v143 MSVC, Windows SDK 10.0.26100.0, C++20 Debug, and CTest 4.4.2.
behavior_proved: the neutral dashboard application factory constructs distinct endpoint-specific immutable application generations and rejects invalid loopback, port, and refresh configuration
the native Manager.Windows layer depends on the dashboard factory interface and lower Windows dashboard transport without linking back to the Application implementation
initial Manager runtime start publishes a real loopback listener and active operational service without advancing restartCount
pause preserves the dashboard listener while suppressing operational service, and start resumes the same generation without resetting uptime or restart count
a same-endpoint factory failure occurs before destructive cutover, retains the healthy old listener and application, records the error, and preserves exactly one attempted restart count
successful same-endpoint restart drains, waits, destroys, and replaces the exclusive Winsock/IOCP graph before the successor serves on the same port
distinct-endpoint rebind uses the lower A/B path, publishes the successor, preserves the desired paused operational state, and releases the retired endpoint
nonbinding settings cannot silently change host or port and do not replace the application or advance restartCount
shutdown intent remains distinct from final drain: the runtime latches intent while the listener remains available, and idempotent final shutdown releases the port
dashboard post-delivery shutdown publishes the process-stop edge only after the controller successfully latches intent, while named-pipe shutdown retains its acknowledgement-before-self-stop owner
independent re-review found no remaining P0, P1, or P2 issue after delivery-safe stop ownership and exception-unsafe redundant configuration state were corrected

evidence_scope.proved: Source structure, CMake layering, focused native contract behavior, and real IPv4 loopback Manager runtime start/pause/resume/failure/restart/rebind/shutdown behavior on this development machine.
evidence_scope.not_proved: Production Manager executable composition, concrete operational data/doctor/telemetry services, named-pipe retained-worker quiescence, watchdog recovery, Task Scheduler startup, live Edge behavior, packaged UI automation, or the authoritative G16 gate.

remaining_limitations: P16 remains in progress and G16 remains not started.
The production Manager executable cannot yet be composed without real operational-data, doctor, and telemetry implementations.
Named-pipe terminal worker quiescence must be proved before the process lease can be released.
The Manager restart transition worker, in-process listener watchdog, and per-user Task Scheduler startup service remain pending.
Live Edge dashboard behavior and retained native UI Automation remain pending.
